name: r15_fillet_on_the_internal_edge
why: Two L extrusions with a fillet on the inner edge, and the base widens. The fillet is on an edge that the change does not touch: it must stay, and stay at 8. It serves to avoid making people believe that everything always comes off -- half the value of this suite is in the cases that HOLD.
intent_why: the fillet is hooked to the inner edge of the L, which the width of the base does not move. The radius stays 8, and the fillets stay one: it is «as it was», and that is indeed how it is written.

after.tolerance_why: the bounding box is read with GetExtremePoint
the fillet leaves a cylindrical face of radius 8: the diameter is read from CylinderParams
